html: Like Richard Phillips SciFi my new facebook page where I post updates on my current projects, things that inspire my science fiction, short personal videos, and answers to common questions I get from fans and other writers. I also periodically post author giveaways, not just books and teasers but things like signed author bookplates (stickers) so that fans can turn their paperback books into author signed copies.
